verdicts.reason: A: the three tag chips are enlarged to nearly button size and stacked in a staggered, zig-zag pattern, so they compete with the CTA. The date is centred while the details below it are left-aligned, and the missing-asset placeholder is enlarged with its text clipped at the bottom-right. B: the 'RSVP Free' CTA is shrunk to chip size and paired side by side with 'FREE ENTRY', so the main action is buried among the tags. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' is jammed tiny beside the logo, and there is a large dead gap between the illustration and the buttons. A keeps the CTA as the clear focal point, so it is the less bad of the two.
